note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real in Git Bash scripts via 'bash'. Only one F0 Language resource may exist per subscription; purge soft-deleted ones first (az cognitiveservices account list-deleted -o table).
prepare: # laptop toolchain for the bash scripts: Git Bash first on PATH, python3 and zip shims in %TEMP% (the laptop has neither)

$shim = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'mgshim'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $shim | Out-Null; [IO.File]::WriteAllText("$shim\python3", "#!/bin/bash`nexec python `"`$@`"`n"); [IO.File]::WriteAllText("$shim\zip.py", "import sys,os,zipfile`nz=zipfile.ZipFile(os.path.abspath(sys.argv[-2]),'w',zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED)`n[z.write(os.path.join(r,n),os.path.relpath(os.path.join(r,n),'.').replace(os.sep,'/')) for r,d,f in os.walk('.') for n in f]`nz.close()`n"); [IO.File]::WriteAllText("$shim\zip", "#!/bin/bash`nexec python `"`$(dirname `"`$0`")/zip.py`" `"`$@`"`n")
az account show --query name -o none 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { az login --use-device-code }   # owner signs in as labadmin
if (-not (Get-Command jq -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { winget install --id jqlang.jq -e --silent --accept-source-agreements --accept-package-agreements }
# the deployment is the first screen (recorded); the role comes later in the 'run' screen

screens.name: deploy

steps: Open rg-mglab-azure-10 > the Language resource > Overview: pricing tier Free (F0), location West Europe, endpoint
Access control (IAM) > Role assignments: no data role for labadmin on this resource (inherited Owner may show; point out that none is a data role)

screens.note: Expect the what-if table with one Create and the outputs (accountName, endpoint). The portal half is a browser capture done by the owner.

screens.name: denied
mask: endpoint host in the error if it appears
screens.note: Expected: a failure with HTTP 401 or 403, the hint about the role, exit code 3. Record exactly what comes back; if it succeeds (a role inherited from the subscription) that is a finding.

screens.name: run
commands: $n = 0; do { bash infra/run.sh; $ok = ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0); if (-not $ok) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 30 }; $n++ } until ($ok -or $n -ge 12)   # role assignments can take up to five minutes
screens.note: Expect seven JSON lines (id, language, sentiment, piiCategories, redactedText, route) and on standard error 'text records (billed this run): 21 ...'. Read the routes as the real service decided (card ticket T-1004 expected security-review; a missed PII category is itself a finding). Note how long the role took.

screens.name: rest
screens.note: First call with the bearer token: HTTP 200 with detectedLanguage pt. Second call with a made-up key: record the exact status and message (expected 401 or 403, not verified).

teardown: bash infra/teardown.sh rg-mglab-azure-10 westeurope   # deletes the group, then purges the account (frees the F0 slot and the name)
az cognitiveservices account list-deleted -o table   # nothing left for this account
